ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with a roughly 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels on the lateral lobes to low-intensity (black) pixels in the central and peripheral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central region radiating from the peduncle. Contiguous high-intensity regions occupy approximately 65% of each lobe's surface. High-frequency black mottling and speckling are concentrated at the interface between the central dark mass and the white lateral fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 68 degrees and a deep vertical displacement relative to the lobe mid-line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile. The right lobe (viewer perspective) shows higher amplitude peaks and deeper valleys (jaggedness) compared to the left lobe. A distinct deep notch is visible approximately 20% inward from the right tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with initial concavity near the median notch transitioning to a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-relief, high-intensity circular nodes (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Several circular white ring-scars are detected within the low-intensity central pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-intensity linear disruptions detected. One prominent vertical mark on the inner left lobe; two parallel, high-contrast diagonal rake marks on the mid-right lobe; several smaller horizontal scratches on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both lobes and significant barnacle encrustation on the trailing edge tips. Distinct white circular puncture/parasitic scars near the central notch area.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive pair of adjacent circular scars located approximately 150 pixels to the right of the median notch vertex within the dark pigment field.
